summary: Enable customer-managed audit log export (checklist + approvals)  AcmeBank (Dedicated)
description:
Issue summary:
Customer (AcmeBank) requests automated export of Redwood platform audit logs to their AWS S3 bucket for SIEM ingestion. This is a Dedicated deployment.

Impact:
Blocking a scheduled internal audit. Customer requested completion by 2025-11-28.

Environment:
- Customer tier: dedicated
- Dedicated cluster: ded-acmebank-us-east-1
- Region: us-east-1

Requested destination:
- Sink: S3
- Bucket: acmebank-redwood-audit-prod
- Prefix: redwood/audit/org=acmebank/dedicated=ded-acmebank-us-east-1
- Destination region: us-east-1

Auth approach:
- Assume-role into customer account (no static keys stored)
- Customer provided role ARN: arn:aws:iam::555555555555:role/RedwoodAuditExportWriter

Checklist (must be completed):
1) Intake complete (CS): customer, mode, region, sink, retention intent, contacts
2) Security approval on destination policy and encryption
3) Legal check (only if cross-region or bespoke PII request)
4) Dedicated runbook execution (Terraform config + apply)
5) Validation: connector metrics + objects landing
6) Customer confirmation + closeout note

Links:
- Controls page: confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/customer-managed-audit-log-export-controls
- Dedicated runbook: confluence/eng-infra/runbooks/dedicated-audit-log-export-customer-setup
- Architecture: confluence/architecture-and-standards/observability-standards/audit-log-export-architecture
comments:
Lauren Bishop (2025-11-18): Created per SOP. Customer audit deadline 11/28. Please confirm if any contract gating needed.

Priya Natarajan (2025-11-19): Security review: OK. Bucket has SSE-KMS enabled. Role policy is scoped to PutObject on the specific prefix and ListBucket limited to the prefix. Approved for enablement.

Connor OBrien (2025-11-20): Confirmed this is regional (us-east-1 to us-east-1). Proceeding with default Redwood-managed connector mode.

Connor OBrien (2025-11-21): Applied Terraform update in infra/dedicated/acmebank. Set audit_export.enabled=true, sink=s3, region=us-east-1, destination bucket + prefix, auth_reference=role arn.

Evelyn Hart (2025-11-21): Checked connector dashboards. delivery_success_rate 1.0 for last 30m, lag under 90s. No 4xx errors.

Lauren Bishop (2025-11-22): Customer confirms objects arriving under prefix and SIEM ingest working.

Connor OBrien (2025-11-26): Closing. Reminder: at-least-once semantics; customer deduping by event_id.
